x: Now that Pete Lowe has recovered from his injury we look forward to having him in both these events. Steve Gibson can do really good performances in the Long Jump and Geoff.
In the field events we fared rather better than usual, and in both the Long Jump and the Hop, Step and Jump we took third and fourth places, through P.
The Hop, Step and Jump championship was won by P. Lowe with 41 ft. 4½ in., which is quite a good effort, but we are in dire need of some jumpers in the club ranks for the Triple, High and Long Jumps.

Pete Lowe's new record in the Hop, Step and Jump and Bob Cooper's equalling of the High Jump record were the only other highlights, except for Paul Bower's fine throw in the Surrey Junior Javelin, which he won with a new record of 175 ft. 6½ ins.
Miska, one of our Latvian members, won the weight handicap, with P.
